metadata.scope: Offline condition-blinded assessment of the 35 valid Juanita responses in this partial snapshot. The reviewer participated in corpus authoring; this is not independent clinical validation. All 33 earlier judgments and reasons remain unchanged; only the two new responses were newly assessed. No reports, results, condition mappings, run data, provider logs, or API services were accessed. Operational failures and missing answers are not assigned semantic judgments.
metadata.method: The two new complete answers were read semantically against their question, source-based gold, and unchanged frozen rubric; distinction between completion and planning and appropriate abstention were assessed.
metadata.ambiguity_note: Nessuna ambiguità nelle due nuove risposte: astensione null corretta sul materiale mai specificato e distinzione esplicita corretta fra esercizio completato e soltanto pianificato.
